name: Improved Cushion The Blow [Psionic]
body:
Your damage prevention blocks multiple attacks.

Prerequisite: Wisdom 15, Cushion the Blow, Collective class feature, manifester level 12th.

Benefit: When using the Cushion the Blow feat, the effect can be applied to an additional attack with a melee, ranged, or natural weapon in the same round.
